name: Apse
_about: AN APSE: a half ring of wall with a window in every bay, and over it a half dome (a vault) or a half cone (a roof's skin, `domeT` 0, `trigonal`) -- set against the end of a choir, its open side (-z) closed by the choir's end wall, which must stand higher than the dome's crown (the check reports a half dome OPEN to the sky otherwise). Place it at the middle of the choir's end, yawed to bulge outward.

params._R: the apse's inside radius; T its walls; H their height; n the bays of the whole circle it is half of (a multiple of four)
params._profile: the half dome's section; domeT 0 makes it a roof's skin (a half cone: `trigonal` with `rise`), `over` its eave past the wall

walls._about: the half ring of wall, a window in every bay, bulging toward +z (its open side, -z, against the choir's end wall)

half dome._about: the half dome over it -- or its half-cone roof
